newsitem.title: UK: DB Capital Markets sets warrants on CAC-40 index.
newsitem.headline: DB Capital Markets sets warrants on CAC-40 index.

text.p: DB Capital Markets has issued 10 million American-style call and put warrants, in 10 equal tranches, on the CAC 40 index, lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said.
